const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Trajectory controller for the rcb-limited/2.2 RoboPaint episode."""
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)
+MM = 0.227185 / 1024.0
+
+
+def move_tip(robot, destination, *, speed=0.16, dwell_s=0.0, cameras=("canvas_cam", "side_cam"), note=""):
+    """Linearly move the vertical brush tip; use <= 0.25 m/s and settle at the endpoint."""
+    now = np.asarray(robot.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    start = now[7:14]
+    end = np.r_[np.asarray(destination, dtype=float), DOWN]
+    distance = float(np.linalg.norm(end[:3] - start[:3]))
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(distance / (speed * 0.05))))
+    rows = [start + (end - start) * (i / n) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
+    rows.extend([end.copy()] * int(np.ceil(dwell_s / 0.05)))
+    result = robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(rows), dt=0.05, cameras=list(cameras), video="mp4", note=note)
+    print("move", note, "distance", distance, "steps", len(rows), "time_left", result.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+          "plan", result.meta.get("plan"), "clipped", result.meta.get("clipped"))
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    print("protocol", spec["protocol"], "budget", robot.status())
+    # Service coordinates inferred from the calibrated top-down views: the ink well
+    # is centred at approximately (-0.098, +0.150) m, on the robot's left.
+    r = move_tip(robot, [-0.098, 0.150, 0.105], dwell_s=0.25,
+                 cameras=("canvas_cam", "scene_cam", "side_cam"), note="approach ink stone")
+    r.save("/app/runs/approach_ink")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
const result = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
